descriptor: Design and engineering notes from a product team

voice.summary: Writes like a good colleague explaining what worked, with numbers rather than hype. Headlines make one clear claim and the excerpt gives the evidence.
dos: Lead with the result, then the method
Use one number per excerpt where possible
donts: No claims without the measured outcome

taglines: What we tried and what held
Fewer clever ideas, more finished ones
boilerplate: Fieldnotes is the working journal of a product team, publishing short essays on design, engineering, product and culture, each with the evidence behind the opinion.

microcopy.empty: No posts match that search yet

logo.note: An open book suits a journal of written-down lessons.
